title: Personalised news is currently broken because it prioritises engagement over understanding.
body:
Most algorithms are designed to keep you scrolling. They feed you more of what you already click on. This creates a feedback loop that narrows your perspective rather than expanding it. It is efficient for ad revenue but terrible for staying informed.

At Headlinne, we are building something different. The roadmap for the next generation of news isn't about better clickbait. It is about control. We are focused on giving you tools to curate your own feeds based on topics you actually care about, not just what the algorithm thinks will keep you online.

We believe the future of news is active, not passive. You should be able to adjust the depth, the tone, and the frequency of your updates. You deserve a news experience that respects your time and your intelligence. We are moving away from the black box and toward a transparent system where you are the editor.
cta: You can see how we are building this at HEADLINNE.com.
